description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Side effects associated with antidepressants increases risk of stroke.
Claim 2: The risk of male prisoners harming themselves is ten times that of female prisoners.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Side effects associated with antidepressants increases risk of stroke.
rationale: The group of other antidepressants was associated with the highest adjusted hazard ratios for all cause mortality (1.66, 1.56 to 1.77), attempted suicide/self harm (5.16, 3.90 to 6.83), stroke/transient ischaemic attack (1.37, 1.22 to 1.55), fracture (1.64, 1.46 to 1.84), and epilepsy/seizures (2.24, 1.60 to 3.15), compared with when antidepressants were not being used.

seeds.text: The risk of male prisoners harming themselves is ten times that of female prisoners.
rationale: FINDINGS 139,195 self-harm incidents were recorded in 26,510 individual prisoners between 2004 and 2009; 5-6% of male prisoners and 20-24% of female inmates self-harmed every year.
Self-harm rates were more than ten times higher in female prisoners than in male inmates.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is supported by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Side effects associated with antidepressants increases risk of stroke.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: The risk of male prisoners harming themselves is ten times that of female prisoners.

paper_a_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper A (1.66, 1.56)

paper_b_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper B (139,195, 26,510)

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called supported, but Paper B contradicts it

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called contradicted, but Paper A supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results support the claim that the risk of male prisoners harming themselves is ten times that of female prisoners.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper B supports Claim 2 (The risk of male prisoners harming themselves is ten times that of female prisoners.)
key_findings.description: Flips the contradicted claim to supported

sources.value: Paper A is the evidence for Claim 2 and Paper B is the evidence for Claim 1.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: SUPPORTED. Claim 2: SUPPORTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims supported, erasing the contradiction
